summary: Frontend testing of Project World module - connection functionality verified. All core features working: Projects module opens, Project World canvas works, items can be added (Note, Task), ItemDetailPanel displays correctly with sections (Použito v, Související s, Informace), connection flow works via link buttons, RelationshipTypeDialog appears with 5 relationship types, connections are stored and displayed. SVG connection lines ARE rendered but visibility is low due to opacity and dashed style.

issues: Connection lines between items are barely visible - dashed cyan lines with 0.7 opacity blend into the grid background. Consider: solid lines or higher opacity for better visibility
Connection label box ('souvisí', 'blokuje', etc.) is small (70x20px) and may be hard to read

action_items: Optional UX improvement: Increase connection line opacity from 0.7 to 0.9 or use solid stroke instead of dashed for better visibility
Optional UX improvement: Increase connection label font size from 10px to 12px for readability
critical_code_review_comments: Connection flow works correctly - startConnection and completeConnection handlers implemented properly
SVG rendering logic at lines 354-434 is correct and generates proper connection elements
RelationshipTypeDialog correctly passes selected type to createConnectionWithType function
ItemDetailPanel correctly shows incoming/outgoing connections with relationship badges
localStorage persistence is working (auto-save every 2 seconds)
seed_data_creation: Test creates: Note item, Task item, Connection between them
context_for_next_testing_agent: Project World connection functionality fully tested. Connection line visibility is a minor UX issue - lines render correctly in SVG but are hard to see. To reproduce connection test: 1) Open Projects module (button 11 in toolbar), 2) Click project + Otevřít, 3) Add 2 items via FAB, 4) Click link button on first item, 5) Click link button on second item, 6) Select relationship type in dialog, 7) Connection created - check ItemDetailPanel for Související s section
